description.value: Powder Mountain Lodge is a motel in Fernie, BC that has been operating since 1970, offering six room types from economy queens to five-bedroom kitchen suites with full kitchens. It sits centrally in town off Highway 3 at 9th Street, placing guests within a short walk of downtown pubs, restaurants, and shops, and a short drive from Fernie Alpine Resort and mountain biking trails. The lodge has an outdoor courtyard pool, indoor hot tub, guest kitchen, BBQ area, common room with pool and snooker tables, and a fireplace lounge.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail about Powder Mountain Lodge. Amenities confirmed from the /amenities/ page include free Wi-Fi (stated multiple times), outdoor pool, indoor hot tub, guest kitchen, BBQ, and free outdoor parking. The website mentions easy access to mountain biking and hiking trails and notes nearby downtown pubs and restaurants a few blocks away, supporting 'Nearby evening food'. No mention of secure bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, pump, tools, or bike wash anywhere on the site. OSM phone +1-250-423-4492 matches the website's 250-423-4492; OSM address '892 Crowsnest Highway' and website '892 Highway 3' refer to the same road (Highway 3 is the Crowsnest Highway).
concerns: OSM lists street as 'Crowsnest Highway'; website uses 'Highway 3' — these are the same road but the OSM tag could be made more consistent with the official civic address shown on the website (892 Highway 3).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel in Fernie with an active website and booking system. Well-located for touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays on Highway 3.

Nearby evening food.detail: Lodge is 'just few blocks from historic downtown where you can enjoy pubs and restaurants' per front page and extended-stays page

wow_evidence: outdoor courtyard pool, indoor hot tub, guest kitchen... operating since 1970
